# ShiftLefter

> A typed behavioral vocabulary over Gherkin, built in Clojure. Define your
> app's actors, actions, and intents once; every scenario is validated against
> that vocabulary at bind time, before anything runs. Drives real browsers
> (pluggable WebDriver/Playwright backend) and SMS. CI-ready: JUnit XML, HTML,
> and EDN output, tag filtering, parallel scenario execution.

This site is a pointer. The repository owns the content.

## Start here

- Repository: https://github.com/shift-lefter/shiftlefter
- Releases: https://github.com/shift-lefter/shiftlefter/releases
- Install (Java 21+ only):
  curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SHIFT-LEFTER/shiftlefter/main/release/install.sh | bash
- After installing, run `sl orient` in any project — it reports the project's
  mode, what would fail, and what to read next. `sl agent-doc --list` names the
  packaged doctrine topics.

## Writing

Essays by the author, on this site. Index: https://shiftlefter.com/writing/ ·
feed: https://shiftlefter.com/writing/feed.xml

- "Your System Is Not Your Application" — your application is the part you
  test; your system is everything a user crosses on the way to their goal,
  and much of it ships unchecked:
  https://shiftlefter.com/writing/2026/08/your-system-is-not-your-application/
- "The Pony Test" — hand a blinded agent nothing but your marketing pitch,
  ask it to derive your product, and grade what it imagines:
  https://shiftlefter.com/writing/2026/08/the-pony-test/
